## Cloud platform pricing

This section covers partner-operated cloud platforms, where the cloud provider invoices you. For Anthropic-operated cloud platforms billed through a marketplace, see Claude Platform on AWS pricing and Claude in Microsoft Foundry pricing.

Claude models are available on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud. For official pricing, visit:

- Amazon Bedrock pricing
...
on AWS pricing

Claude Platform on AWS bills through AWS Marketplace using Claude Consumption Units (CCUs). Anthropic rates your token usage in USD at standard per-model, per-feature rates, applies any negotiated discount, converts the result to CCUs at $0.01 per CCU, and reports the CCU quantity to AWS Marketplace hourly. Your AWS bill shows a single CCU line item.

results.summary:
Summary:
- The page provides detailed, USD-denominated pricing for Anthropic’s Claude models and related features, including various model-specific token pricing, caching fees, and output token costs.
- Model pricing highlights:
  - Claude Fable 5, Mythos 5: base input $10/MTok; cache writes from $12.50–$20/MTok; cache hits $1/MTok; output $50/MTok.
  - Claude Opus series (5, 4.x, etc.): base input $5/MTok; cache writes from $6.25–$10/MTok; cache hits $0.50/MTok; output $25/MTok.
  - Claude Sonnet series: base input $2–$3/MTok; cache writes $2.50–$3.75/MTok; cache hits $0.20–$0.30/MTok; output $10–$15/MTok.
  - Claude Haiku: base input $1/MTok; cache writes $1.25/MTok; cache hits $0.10/MTok; output $5/MTok.
  - Note: Claude Sonnet 5 has standard pricing of $2 per 1M input/output tokens (introductory pricing) with a planned increase delayed and not occurring.
- Cache pricing details explain that the cache-related columns pertain to prompt caching (5-minute writes, 1-hour writes, cache hits & refreshes).
- Cloud platform pricing:
  - Claude models are available on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud; pricing may vary by platform. Regional endpoints add a 10% premium.
  - Claude Platform on AWS and Claude in Microsoft Foundry use Claude Consumption Units (CCUs) billed via the respective marketplaces at $0.01 per CCU, converting token usage into CCUs after applying any discounts.
- For the most current pricing, the page directs users to claude.com/pricing.

If you need pricing for a specific model or platform (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Bedrock, or Foundry) or a quick comparison for a given usage scenario, I can tailor a concise breakdown.
